Male Executive Assistant Job at KarFerry Limited




        
    

        
        KarFerry Limited, a recruitment company with branches in Island and Ikeja, is  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Male Executive Assistant
Job Location: Omole Phase 2, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and professional Male Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative, operational, and personal support to the Managing Director / CEO.
	The ideal candidate must be trustworthy, discreet, resourceful, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage the CEO’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule.
	Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes, and follow up on action points.
	Handle correspondence, emails, reports, presentations, and other official documents.
	Serve as a key point of contact between the CEO and staff, clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
	Conduct research and prepare briefs, summaries, and reports for management.
	Follow up on tasks delegated by the CEO and ensure timely completion.
	Arrange business meetings, travel, accommodation, and itineraries when required.
	Maintain confidential company and executive information.
	Assist with administrative and operational tasks as assigned by the CEO.
	Monitor important deadlines, appointments, projects, and commitments.
	Represent the CEO professionally when communicating with internal and external contacts.
	Support the CEO in coordinating personal and business-related schedules where necessary.
	Handle other duties that may reasonably be assigned by management.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Management, Economics, Communications, or a related field with 2 – 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Administrative Officer, or similar role.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and other productivity tools.
	Good understanding of business administration and office procedures.
	Ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
	Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
	Willingness to work flexible hours when required.
	Must be professional, presentable, reliable, and highly responsible.
	Valid driver’s license and good driving experience may be an added advantage, especially where the role involves supporting the executive with movement and errands.


Key Skills:


	Executive and administrative support
	Calendar and diary management
	Excellent communication
	Time management
	Organization and multitasking
	Report and document preparation
	Meeting coordination
	Research and problem-solving
	Confidentiality and discretion
	Microsoft Office proficiency
	Follow-up and task management
	Attention to detail
	Professional etiquette
	Interpersonal and relationship-management skills
	Ability to work independently

  "title": "Head of Human Resources (HR)",
  "description": "Tybtitx Services International Limited - Our client in the retail industry is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Head of Human Resources (HR)&nbsp;

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Our client is in need of an experienced, strategic, and people-focused Head of HR to lead the organization&rsquo;s human resources function, strengthen HR processes, drive employee engagement, and develop effective talent management strategies across the business.
	The ideal candidate will have strong leadership capabilities, in-depth knowledge of HR best practices, and the ability to align people strategies with organizational objectives.
	The successful candidate will oversee recruitment, employee relations, performance management, HR operations, organizational development, and compliance while building strong relationships with employees, management, clients, and other key stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and initiatives aligned with the organization&rsquo;s business objectives and workforce needs.
	Lead and oversee the full recruitment and talent acquisition process, ensuring the organization attracts, selects, and retains high-quality talent.
	Oversee onboarding, workforce planning, performance management, employee development, succession planning, and employee retention initiatives.
	Build and maintain a positive workplace culture by promoting employee engagement, collaboration, accountability, and professional development.
	Manage employee relations, including addressing grievances, resolving workplace concerns, handling disciplinary matters, and ensuring the fair and consistent application of company policies.
	Review, develop, and continuously improve HR policies, procedures, and organizational structures to enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
	Ensure accurate and timely management of employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave, payroll coordination, and other HR operations.
	Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, employment regulations, company policies, and organizational standards.
	Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, employees, management, and other key stakeholders.
	Work closely with clients and internal teams to understand workforce requirements, provide appropriate HR solutions, and ensure effective delivery of staffing and people-related services where applicable.
	Provide strategic HR advice and recommendations to senior management on workforce planning, employee performance, organizational development, and people-related matters.
	Prepare and present HR reports, workforce insights, and recommendations to management to support informed business decisions.
	Lead, mentor, and develop the HR team, ensuring effective performance, accountability, and achievement of departmental objectives.
	Identify HR challenges and implement practical solutions that improve employee productivity, engagement, and overall business performance.
	Maintain strict confidentiality when handling employee, client, and organizational information.


Qualifications &amp; Requirements

Head of Human Resources (HR) Job at Tybtitx Services International Limited




        
    

        
        Tybtitx Services International Limited - Our client in the retail industry is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Head of Human Resources (HR) 

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Our client is in need of an experienced, strategic, and people-focused Head of HR to lead the organization’s human resources function, strengthen HR processes, drive employee engagement, and develop effective talent management strategies across the business.
	The ideal candidate will have strong leadership capabilities, in-depth knowledge of HR best practices, and the ability to align people strategies with organizational objectives.
	The successful candidate will oversee recruitment, employee relations, performance management, HR operations, organizational development, and compliance while building strong relationships with employees, management, clients, and other key stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and initiatives aligned with the organization’s business objectives and workforce needs.
	Lead and oversee the full recruitment and talent acquisition process, ensuring the organization attracts, selects, and retains high-quality talent.
	Oversee onboarding, workforce planning, performance management, employee development, succession planning, and employee retention initiatives.
	Build and maintain a positive workplace culture by promoting employee engagement, collaboration, accountability, and professional development.
	Manage employee relations, including addressing grievances, resolving workplace concerns, handling disciplinary matters, and ensuring the fair and consistent application of company policies.
	Review, develop, and continuously improve HR policies, procedures, and organizational structures to enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
	Ensure accurate and timely management of employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave, payroll coordination, and other HR operations.
	Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, employment regulations, company policies, and organizational standards.
	Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, employees, management, and other key stakeholders.
	Work closely with clients and internal teams to understand workforce requirements, provide appropriate HR solutions, and ensure effective delivery of staffing and people-related services where applicable.
	Provide strategic HR advice and recommendations to senior management on workforce planning, employee performance, organizational development, and people-related matters.
	Prepare and present HR reports, workforce insights, and recommendations to management to support informed business decisions.
	Lead, mentor, and develop the HR team, ensuring effective performance, accountability, and achievement of departmental objectives.
	Identify HR challenges and implement practical solutions that improve employee productivity, engagement, and overall business performance.
	Maintain strict confidentiality when handling employee, client, and organizational information.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Management, Psychology, or a related field.
	Minimum 7 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years in a managerial or leadership capacity.
	Professional HR certification such as CIPM, SHRM, HRCI, or an equivalent qualification is an advantage.
	Strong knowledge of HR policies, employment practices, labor laws, employee relations, and HR best practices.
	Proven experience managing recruitment, performance management, employee engagement, talent development, and HR operations.
	Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, conflict-resolution, and interpersonal skills.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with the capacity to handle complex employee and organizational matters.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced business environment.
	Strong client relationship and stakeholder management skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR management systems.
	Ability to handle confidential employee, client, and organizational information with discretion and professionalism.
	Strong business acumen and the ability to partner effectively with senior management to support organizational growth and performance.
	Available to work Monday- Saturday.
